description: This Java class 'DOMSettingsBuilder' is responsible for serializing a 'Settings' object into an XML format, including various user interface and application configuration settings. It builds an XML DOM structure with multiple sections representing different settings categories and writes it to an output file.

classes.name: DOMSettingsBuilder
classes.description: A utility class that constructs an XML document representing application settings and writes it to a file.

methods.name: buildSettings
methods.description: Serializes the provided Settings object into an XML structure and writes it to the specified output file, updating progress via JProgressPane.

methods.name: buildWindow
methods.description: Creates an XML node containing window-related settings such as size, location, and maximized state.

methods.name: buildFiles
methods.description: Creates an XML node with file paths for image directory, repository, and ECU definition files.

methods.name: buildOptions
methods.description: Creates an XML node with various application options, including warnings, debug mode, user level, and version number.

methods.name: buildTableDisplay
methods.description: Creates an XML node for table display settings like font, cell size, and color schemes.

methods.name: buildLogger
methods.description: Creates an XML node with logger configuration, including connection settings, window state, and plugin ports.

methods.name: buildTableClipboardFormat
methods.description: Creates an XML node defining the clipboard format for tables.

methods.name: buildIcons
methods.description: Creates an XML node for icon scales used in editor and table views.
